material.acceptance_criteria: scripts/package/install-check.sh, run on an archive from build.sh, checks that the unpacked archive contains each of: js/client/play.html, play.js, rooms.js, ice.js, delta.js, wire/frame.js, glb.js, models/ (a directory with at least one file), pkg/ (web.js and web_bg.wasm), map.bin. It exits non-zero with FAIL naming the member when any one is absent or empty.
material.description: Owner decision (witness-log, gm-orch-1-r4): js/host was removed on purpose (docs/HOST.md:62), so the node js/host/server.js acceptance is dropped. The release archive is built by scripts/package/build.sh, which stages js/client (play.html, play.js, rooms.js, ice.js, delta.js, wire/frame.js, glb.js, models/, pkg/, map.bin) and writes every staged file into MANIFEST.sha256. The row closes when scripts/package/install-check.sh proves the unpacked archive holds every one of those members and fails when one is missing. Current install-check.sh checks play.html, play.js, rooms.js, ice.js, delta.js, wire/frame.js, map.bin and pkg/ but not glb.js or models/.
material.resolution: verifier: install-check fails on missing glb.js or models/. CI run 39065835817 success on tip e03ee19 (24/24 jobs), which contains this sha
material.witness: verifier: install-check fails on missing glb.js or models/. CI run 39065835817 success on tip e03ee19 (24/24 jobs), which contains this sha
material.witness_plan: CI only: wasm-pack is not installed on this host, so the witness is the CI job that runs build.sh and then install-check.sh on the pushed sha, read through ci-status. Two-sided: the same check must fail when glb.js or models/ is removed from the unpacked tree (the negative arm), shown in the CI log.
